opportunity.reason: A high-priority controlled asset cannot be pushed safely before its factual, canonical and content audit.
recommended_actions: Audit visible facts, title, biography, current status, canonical and indexability
Remove or noindex thin, duplicate or solicitation content
Assign a distinct query intent and editorial role

factors.formula: impact × authority × relevance × control ÷ (time + financial cost + risk)

approval_bundle_requirements: Expected benefit, cost, risk and measurement plan
Exact proposed change or outreach text
measurement_after_action: Re-measure the same engine, surface, query and locale
Stop or reverse if risk, duplication or cannibalization rises
